Yuki Kowalski
yuki.kowalski@example.com | Detroit, MI
Yuki Kowalski has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Beacon Systems (2023-2026), where
they led migration of core services at Beacon Systems onto AWS, improving
uptime during peak load. Before that, Backend Engineer at Bedrock Platform
(2022-2023). Before that, Software Engineer I at Windmere Technologies
(2018-2022). Education: B.S. Software Engineering, Virginia Tech, 2018. Core
skills: Microservices, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Kubernetes, AWS, Node.js, Java,
TypeScript, Redis, REST API design, Terraform, Distributed systems.
